system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $1.80 free starting credit, Flux-Schnell priced at $0.0008 per image (approx. 2250 free images)
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides lightning-fast API endpoints for Flux-Schnell and SDXL with no IP blocks on GitHub Actions runners, at rates far cheaper than standard API providers.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace the failing Pollinations/AI Horde fallback in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' tasks running inside GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires a valid phone number for initial free credit verification. Pay-as-you-go requires a credit card once free credits are exhausted.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free Google search queries on signup, reset or reusable with new API keys
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides clean JSON Google Search and Google Images scraping results without getting blocked by CAPTCHAs, which happens instantly on raw GitHub Actions runners.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into 'agent_trendhunter' and 'agent_opportunity_hunter' to scrape high-intent keywords and trending search terms automatically.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strictly limited to search results metadata; does not scrape full page contents, but perfect for trend tracking.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly fee, 5% + $0.50 per transaction fee
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as a Merchant of Record. They handle global sales tax and EU VAT compliance automatically, which is mandatory and complex for Hugo operating from France.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Sell digital gamedev asset packs, SVG packs, and PDF coloring books directly using simple static HTML links generated by GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payouts are weekly and require verification of identity (KYC) to comply with financial regulations.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list unlimited assets, 88/12 revenue share (you keep 88%)
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The newly unified successor to Unreal Engine Marketplace, Sketchfab, and Quixel. Massive built-in traffic of game developers looking for 2D/3D assets.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Publish the outputs of 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' and 'produce_stl_parametric' directly to tap into the game-dev economy.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Asset quality review can take several days; requires strict adherence to technical submission guidelines.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $10 free credits upon account creation. Flux.schnell costs $0.003/image (~3300 free images)
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Ultra-low latency inference engine optimized for media generation. Features advanced image-to-image and upscaling pipelines (like AuraSR) out of the box via simple REST API.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Use in 'produce_coloring_book' to upscale generated images to 300 DPI print-ready PDFs directly on GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Rate limits on free tiers can be tight during peak hours.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free, no hosting or listing fees, Printify handles production and customer service
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows launching a fully-functional storefront without setting up Shopify, Etsy, or WooCommerce, bypassing Etsy's upfront listing fees entirely.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Deploy generated designs from 'produce_tumbler_wraps' and 'produce_wedding_stationery' to a direct-to-consumer link.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Organic search traffic is non-existent; Hugo must drive traffic via social channels or SEO.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free distribution and formatting, they take 10% of the retail price upon sale
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Distributes low-content and high-content ebooks/paperbacks to multiple global platforms simultaneously (Kobo, Barnes & Noble, Vivlio, Apple Books), bypassing Amazon-only reliance.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Export outputs from 'produce_chess_book' and 'produce_lowcontent_kdp' to reach the European market (Vivlio/Tolino) directly.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Some platforms distributed by D2D have strict guidelines against low-content books; must focus on high-quality structured coloring/activity books.
